title: Mechanical watch stopped by the emitter
summary: Luigi Vendetelli tells of Mechanical watch stopped by the emitter, about late 1980s at S4, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it was like a mechanical watch that just stopped.

plain: A researcher, Luigi Vendetelli, passes on a detail from Bob Lazar, a man who says that in the late 1980s he worked at S4, a secret site in Nevada. As Vendetelli tells it, Lazar describes a device called the emitter that made a mechanical watch simply stop. If true, it would point to a strange technology whose effects reached ordinary objects nearby.
